newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Communists say budget accord on income tax.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Communists say budget accord on income tax.

text.p: Italy's hard-left Communist Refoundation party said on Friday that it had reached an agreement with the government on income tax (Irpef) amendments contained in the 1997 draft budget.

"We've reached agreement on Irpef," Oliviero Diliberto, the party's leader in the Chamber of Deputies (lower house), told reporters. He said the government had undertaken not to increase the tax burden on low to medium income brackets.

Communist Refoundation leader Fausto Bertinotti said earlier that his party, which holds the balance of power in the Chamber, would support Prime Minister Romano Prodi's centre-left government over the 1997 budget.
